title: On the generalized Ree curve
summary: Let p be an odd prime, let q_0 := p^s with s >= 1, and put q := p q_0^2. We study the smooth projective curve R_{p,s} with function field F_q(x,y,z), y^q - y = x^{q_0}(x^q - x), z^q - z = x^{2q_0}(x^q - x). The two-equation layer is already present in the ray-class and big-action literature; for p = 3 it gives the classical Ree curve. In analogy with the generalized Suzuki curve, we call R_{p,s} the generalized Ree curve associated with p and s.
